Question #: 1.Title: Exam AD0-E556 topic 1 question 30 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: An Adobe Marketo Engage Architect needs to build a subscription center that contains an option to “pause notifications for 30 days” to dissuade people from unsubscribing. If a person fills out the form and selects this feature, Marketing wants to Marketing Suspend them for 30 days and subtract five points from the lead. Existing records whose notifications are currently paused should be excluded from the flow to avoid double processing.
Which order of steps is required to build this program?
A. Remove from Flow (Existing) > Change data value > Change Score > Wait > Change data value
B. Remove from Flow (Existing) > Change Score > Wait > Change data value > Change data value
C. Change data value > Remove from Flow (Existing) > Change Score > Wait > Change data value
D. Change Score > Change data value > Wait > Change data value > Remove from Flow (Existing)
